transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having pain in both of my knees. It's been going on for several years now, but it's gotten a lot worse over the last few months.
Do you have any allergies to medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies that I know of.
On a scale from 0 to 10, with 0 being no pain and 10 being the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is the pain in your knees these days?
I'm not sure about putting a number on it, but it's bad enough that it's affecting my daily activities now.
Can you tell me about all the medicines you take, including any new or changed ones and the doses if you know them?
For my knees, I've been taking anti-inflammatory medicines. I couldn't tell you the exact doses, though. I've also had cortisone injections and Synvisc injections in the knees.
Can you tell me about any operations you've had?
I haven't had any operations. That's actually part of why I'm here — I want to know if surgery is something that could help me.
Besides the pain itself, have you noticed anything else going on with your knees?
No, I haven't noticed anything else besides the pain itself — no swelling or anything like that. What bothers me is just how much it's affecting what I can do day to day.
What kinds of things seem to make your knee pain worse?
I can't say I've noticed anything specific that sets it off — it just seems to be getting worse over time. What I do know is that the medicines and the injections only ever gave me temporary relief.
Can you describe what the pain in your knees actually feels like?
I can't really put it into words beyond just a constant ache in both knees — nothing sharp or stabbing that I've noticed. It's just there, and it's gotten worse.
Is there anything else about your past health that you'd like to add?
No, I don't think there's anything else worth mentioning. My main worry is the knees and what can be done about them.
Which of these best describes the medicines you take at the moment: you take some every day, you take some only when you need them, or you're not sure?
I take the anti-inflammatory medicines for my knees when I need them — I'm not on anything that I take every day.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
